title: New Sensor - G6 State isn't currently known. Next Connection will update this
symptom: After starting a new Dexcom G6 sensor, xDrip shows the error 'G6 State isn't currently known. Next Connection will update this' and the phone is not connecting to the transmitter after the 2-hour warm-up. The transmitter is not in the Bluetooth connected devices list, and attempts to pair it fail.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible causes discussed include the transmitter being an 8H model with session-restart block, and the need for location services to be enabled on the phone (Android 7+).
fix: The thread does not provide a confirmed fix. Suggestions include ensuring phone location is enabled, following the AndroidAPS xDrip guidelines for G6 transmitter connection, and for restarting 8G/8H+ sensors, a specific procedure involving popping out the transmitter, waiting 20 minutes, cleaning contacts, and restarting with calibration code.
evidence_quote: Do you have location enabled on your phone and watch? This is a common problem. It's necessary to have it on in Android 7+.
